variants.title: Standing orders
variants.premise: The guard is at his post by the berth, watching the gangplank.

lines.speaker: P
lines.text: Is there a boat here that'll take me out of Varlamore?

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: There is. You can't board it.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: My orders. Strangers don't board unvouched.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: My captain. He gets his from higher.

variants.title: Cargo only
variants.premise: The guard has stood since dawn while the charter ship loads spice.

lines.speaker: P
lines.text: How do I book passage on that ship?

lines.speaker: X
lines.text: Dockers carry a spice crate past you.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: The crates have permission. You don't.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Someone with a desk. Not me.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: It's the post I was given.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: The Kualti get the good stuff.

lines.speaker: P
lines.text: No, but it's out of the sun.

variants.title: The quiver
variants.premise: The guard sees Dizana's quiver on the player's back before they've finished the question.

lines.speaker: P
lines.text: I want to sail out. Am I allowed now?

lines.speaker: X
lines.text: The guard looks at the quiver on your back.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: You're the one from the Colosseum.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: Then stopping you isn't my order.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: In the dock building. Can't miss it.

lines.speaker: N
lines.text: I've never had leave for it.
